rationale: Erta brings product management and quantitative analysis experience from medical-robotics at Tendo, while Iman is a principal R&D engineer at Bruin Biometrics with deep expertise in embedded systems, robotics, and medical device development. Their complementary skillsets—product strategy paired with hands-on hardware and software engineering—create a strong foundation for exploring how medical-robotics products move from concept through development and to market.
intro_message: Erta Muca, meet Iman Enayati — both working at the intersection of medical devices and robotics, with complementary expertise in product management and embedded systems R&D.
